[[File:Art Wright DecipherCon 2002.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Art Wright at DecipherCon 2002.]]
'''Arthur Wright''' (also published as '''Art Wright''') was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 117 from Ballston Spa, NY, and a member of [[Team Albany]]. The published fan table marks the Squadron Member slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (geocities.ws/plarathas). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref>

He and [[Aaron Kingery]] flew to Kissimmee early for [[DecipherCon 2000]]. He was in the open-gaming room when the Terwilligers arrived Wednesday night; [[Chris Terwilliger]] played pickup games with him that night. Sokol saw him on the Day 2 morning. With Kingery and [[Brian Terwilliger]] he built [[Matt Sokol]]'s Day 3 [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list overnight. Team Albany, including Wright, wished Sokol luck before Day 3.<ref name="sokol-dt">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-11-sokols-dcon-2000-reportd1327/ sokols-dcon-2000-report], Matt Sokol, Decktech (11 October 2000)</ref>
